title:
Stage 1 forge tier — increment 2d ONLY: anti-Goodhart at L3 (REQ-6). Authoritative spec: .design/stage1-forge-tier.md REQ-6 + AC-10; sequencing in .design/stage1-forge-tier-kickoff-plan.md. Builds on merged predecessors: foundation (#20, seven-verdict CertVerdict + schema-v2 certs), 2a (#29, proof blocks), 2b (#42, covenant), 2c (#43, the frozen battery that gates proof elaboration). Follow the ACToR read-write-verify-commit loop; commit per coherent sub-unit; self-verify before each commit; revert anything that fails. CRITICAL self-verify (the 2b lesson): run python3 tooling/doc-drift.py and RE-PIN the audited-sha of EVERY design doc whose governed source you touch (audit.rs, mutation.rs, vacuity_solver.rs, check.rs, manifest.rs, etc.), and run req-registry.py --check; finish 0-drift. If low on time or budget, STOP at a sub-unit boundary and report what landed.

SCOPE: REQ-6 anti-Goodhart ONLY (three defenses). OUT OF SCOPE: goal/fill UX (2e, REQ-7), relax engine (2f, REQ-8b), lemma library (3, REQ-9). REQ-3/4/5 are DONE — consume, do not redo.

DELIVERABLES (the three L3 defenses):
(a) ARBITRARY-RESULT RE-ELABORATION (tautology): substitute an opaque/arbitrary result into the proof term; if it STILL elaborates, the ens said nothing about the body -> reject. This is the L3 counterpart of forge/src/vacuity_solver.rs build_tautology_harness; put it beside that module's harnesses. AC-10: rejects a body-ignoring ens (fixture test).
(b) RE-ELABORATION MUTATION: reuse the frozen mutation operator catalogue forge/src/mutation.rs generate() + MUTANT_CAP 64 UNCHANGED — only the KILL CHECK changes, from a per-mutant solver run to 'does the existing proof term still typecheck' (decidable per mutant); survivors keep counting against the floor (Budd-Angluin). AC-10: a test ASSERTS the operator catalogue is SHARED with mutation::generate, not forked; killed/scored reported in the certificate.
(c) DEFINITION-TOWER BUDGET (Q2 default depth 4 / 40 definitions): enforce as a CERTIFY-TIME gate on the discharge path — a tower deeper than the budget yields a refusal/failed certificate. The gating does NOT live in forge audit (its 'gates nothing' projection invariant is shipped, #274, audit-manifest.md REQ-10). forge audit --meaning is the READ-ONLY companion: it prints the unfolded tower and pins its hash in the certificate, gating nothing itself. AC-10: an over-budget tower is refused at certify time and the certificate pins the unfolded tower hash.

SUBSTRATE NOTE: a Lean re-elaboration path already exists — engine.rs replay_interactive / replay_present_proof run lake on authored proofs. Defenses (a)/(b) DRIVE that existing path (result-substitution + per-mutant re-typecheck); do NOT build a new elaborator. PERFORMANCE RISK to watch: up to MUTANT_CAP=64 re-typechecks per item must fit the KernelBudget (Q4 30s/clause) — if it does not, report it and propose a bound rather than silently exceeding. The re-elaboration is Lean-discharge-path work; verify what you can locally and rely on the CI lean job for the Lean-spine path (the local env cannot clone lean-smt, so engine::tests Lean-spine cases skip locally — that is expected, NOT a regression).

GAUNTLET before each commit: cargo test -p forge; clippy -p forge --all-targets -- -D warnings; fmt --check; for any Lean touch, lake build + axiom probe; doc-drift 0-drift (re-pin touched docs); req-registry --check clean; forge check over conformance still matches all v1 golden certs with oracle_subset byte-identical for v1 items. No stubs/TODOs.

REGISTRY: register REQ-6 as REQ-S1-6 (shipped) with typed evidence; regenerate the status view; req-registry.py --check clean. No hand-written ## REQ status table.

SCOPE GUARDS: no cage / combinator-menu change; forge audit MUST stay gating-nothing (the budget gate is certify-time, NOT in audit); do NOT flip the README/docs headline (G1 gate only); never stage .crosslink/hook-config.json or .claude/settings.json; additive certs only for v1 items. NOTE: git push is blocked for you by policy — commit locally, end with a clear summary, and the orchestrator pushes + opens the PR. One branch; ONE increment (2d).
